fusions.name: Decree Blow
fusions.desc: A commanding blow that deals 16 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Sovereign Charge
fusions.desc: A charge through every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage. Your party's damage rises 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Command Presence
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 6 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 10 seconds, drawing 1.5 times the usual threat.

fusions.name: Presiding Calm
fusions.desc: When your health is full, you gain a ward that soaks 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
